prep.outliers.en_description: Detects anomalous observations using IQR or Z-scores and treats them via capping or clipping when points deviate strongly but are not data-entry errors.
zh_examples: 数据里有几个点特别离谱，但确认不是录错了，该怎么处理？
怎么判断哪些是异常值，又不直接删掉它们？
箱线图外的点要怎么处理才不影响模型？
en_examples: How do I handle extreme values that aren't data-entry errors?
Which points should I treat as outliers before modeling?
Should I remove or cap the anomalous observations in my data?

prep.missing.en_description: Fills gaps in tabular data using mean, median, mode, KNN, or iterative regression imputation when rows cannot simply be dropped.
zh_examples: 表里有一堆空值，但不能整行删掉，怎么办？
缺失数据一般怎么填比较合理？
用均值填充还是用别的方法填缺失值？
en_examples: What's the best way to fill in missing values without dropping rows?
How should I impute NaNs in my dataset?
Is mean imputation good enough for my missing data?

prep.duplicates.en_description: Identifies and removes duplicate rows or keys after merging tables or repeated submissions to guarantee record uniqueness.
zh_examples: 合并了好几张表之后好像有重复记录，怎么查？
数据里有重复提交的行，应该怎么去重？
怎么确认每条记录是唯一的？
en_examples: How do I find and remove duplicate rows after merging files?
Why do I have repeated records in my dataset?
How can I check that my data has unique entries?

prep.encoding.en_description: Converts categorical features into numeric form using one-hot, ordinal, or target encoding so models can consume them.
zh_examples: 分类变量怎么变成数字才能放进模型？
独热编码和序号编码什么时候用哪个？
类别特征太多，编码后维度爆炸怎么办？
en_examples: How do I convert categorical columns into numbers for my model?
When should I use one-hot vs ordinal encoding?
My category feature has too many levels—what encoding should I use?

prep.derive.en_description: Creates new interpretable variables from raw columns—ratios, products, polynomials, or binned discretization—when existing fields are insufficient.
zh_examples: 现有字段信息不够，能不能自己造一些新特征？
怎么构造交互项或者做分箱？
把连续变量离散化成几档有什么方法？
en_examples: How can I create new features from existing columns?
What are good ways to build interaction or polynomial terms?
Should I bin this continuous variable into categories?

prep.winsorize.en_description: Compresses extreme values to given quantiles so outliers still exist but no longer dominate analysis or model training.
zh_examples: 不想删掉极端值，但又怕它影响结果，怎么办？
把上下 1% 的值压缩一下是什么操作？
怎么让离群点保留但不至于主导回归？
en_examples: How can I keep extreme values from dominating my results?
What does compressing values to the 1st and 99th percentile mean?
Should I trim or winsorize the tails of my variable?

prep.transform.en_description: Applies power transforms to skewed variables so they become more normal and variance-stabilized, useful before regression or Gaussian-based modeling.
zh_examples: 这个变量右偏得很厉害，怎么把它变得接近正态分布？
收入数据方差随均值变大，有什么办法稳定一下方差？
要不要先做个对数变换再建模？
en_examples: How do I make this skewed variable look more normal before regression?
My feature variance grows with its mean — what transform should I use?
Can I normalize highly skewed numeric features automatically?

prep.balance.en_description: Handles severely imbalanced classification by resampling, class weights, or synthetic examples so the model does not only predict the majority class.
zh_examples: 正样本只占1%，模型全预测成负的了怎么办？
有没有办法让少数类也被模型学到？
分类数据严重不平衡，怎么处理比较好？
en_examples: My classifier only predicts the majority class — how do I fix that?
How can I balance a dataset with 99% negative samples?
What resampling technique works for rare-event classification?

prep.scale.en_description: Standardizes or rescales features with different units so distance-based and gradient-based methods behave reliably.
zh_examples: 特征单位差太多，kmeans结果好像受影响了，要怎么缩放？
这几个指标量纲不一样，先做标准化吗？
归一化和标准化该选哪个？
en_examples: Should I scale my features before running k-means or SVM?
What's the difference between z-score and min-max scaling?
My features have very different units — how do I normalize them?

prep.tsne.en_description: Nonlinearly embeds high-dimensional data into 2D or 3D for visual inspection of clusters, intended only for exploration not downstream modeling.
zh_examples: 高维数据能不能画个二维图看看有没有分群？
t-SNE的 perplexity 参数怎么选？
想可视化一下样本能不能分成几团
en_examples: How can I visualize whether my high-dimensional samples form clusters?
What perplexity should I use for a t-SNE plot?
Is t-SNE suitable as input features for my model?

prep.pca.en_description: Reduces many correlated variables into a few uncorrelated principal components with scree and loading plots for structure discovery.
zh_examples: 变量太多还高度相关，能不能压成几个主成分？
PCA保留几个成分比较合适？
怎么解释主成分载荷？
en_examples: How many principal components should I keep?
Can PCA reduce my highly correlated features?
How do I interpret the loading plot of a PCA?

prep.spectral.en_description: Extracts frequency-domain features such as dominant FFT frequency, spectral entropy and energy shares from long time series to describe periodic structure.
zh_examples: 长时间序列里有哪些周期成分，怎么提取？
想用频域特征描述信号的周期结构
谱熵和主频这些特征怎么算？
en_examples: How do I extract dominant periodic components from a long time series?
What frequency-domain features can describe this signal?
Can spectral features improve my time-series forecasting?

describe.frequency.en_description: Counts and proportions of each category in a categorical variable, useful for an initial look at how a nominal or ordinal variable is distributed.
zh_examples: 这个问卷里每个选项分别有多少人选？占比是多少？
帮我看看性别、学历这些分类字段的分布情况
想知道各品牌销量的占比排名
en_examples: How many respondents picked each option in this question?
What is the proportion of each category in this variable?
Give me a count and percentage breakdown of the categorical columns.

describe.stats.en_description: Summarizes central tendency, dispersion and shape—mean, median, standard deviation, quantiles, skewness and kurtosis—for a first look at numeric data.
zh_examples: 新拿到一批数据，先帮我做个整体的统计摘要吧
这些数值变量的均值、方差、分位数是多少？
数据的分布偏不偏、有没有长尾？
en_examples: Give me a quick summary of the numeric variables in this dataset.
What are the mean, standard deviation and quartiles of these columns?
Is the distribution of my data skewed or heavy-tailed?

describe.crosstab.en_description: Builds a two-way table of joint frequencies and row/column percentages for two categorical variables, revealing their association and interaction pattern.
zh_examples: 性别和是否购买之间有没有关系？做个交叉表看看
两个分类变量放一起，我想看交叉分布和占比
帮我按行、按列算一下百分比
en_examples: Is there an association between gender and purchase behavior?
Show me a two-way table of these two categorical variables with row and column percentages.
How are these two factors distributed when crossed together?

describe.aggregate.en_description: Splits data by one or more grouping variables and computes counts, sums, means or other aggregates per group, ideal for group-level comparison.
zh_examples: 按地区分组算一下各组的平均销售额
帮我按部门汇总人数和总工时
每个月的销量总和是多少？
en_examples: What is the average sales revenue for each region?
Aggregate the data by department and show counts and totals.
Summarize totals by month so I can compare groups.

describe.explore.en_description: One-pass scan of a dataset reporting missing values, data types, unique counts, duplicates and distribution summaries to spot data quality issues early.
zh_examples: 先帮我摸底一下这份数据，有没有缺失和重复
这些列的类型对不对？唯一值有多少？
做个数据体检，看看哪里有问题
en_examples: Do a quick health check of this dataset before analysis.
Which columns have missing values or unexpected data types?
How many unique values and duplicates does each column have?

describe.power.en_description: Determines required sample size or statistical power before an experiment, given effect size, alpha and desired power, to plan adequately powered studies.
zh_examples: 实验还没开始，我得知道至少要招多少人
做这个检验需要多大的样本量才够？
效应量定了，功效要0.8的话要收多少数据？
en_examples: How many participants do I need before running this experiment?
What sample size gives my test 80% power at alpha 0.05?
Can you compute the required sample size from this expected effect size?

test.ttest.en_description: Compares means between two groups using one-sample, independent, or paired t-tests, suitable when data are approximately normal and variances are roughly equal.
zh_examples: 两组人的平均成绩有没有显著差别？
配对前后测量的数据能不能用配对检验？
样本量小而且大概正态，该用什么方法比两组均值？
en_examples: Is there a significant difference in means between these two groups?
Which test should I use to compare before-and-after measurements on the same subjects?
How do I compare two group means when the sample is small and roughly normal?

test.anova.en_description: Tests whether three or more group means differ, or adjusts for a covariate, applicable in designs with one factor and optionally one continuous covariate.
zh_examples: 三组以上的平均值差异该怎么检验？
想控制年龄的影响再比较组间差异有什么办法？
多个组别之间有没有显著差异，用什么分析？
en_examples: How do I test whether means differ across three or more groups?
What method lets me compare group differences while controlling for a covariate?
Is there a significant difference among these multiple groups?

test.wilcoxon.en_description: Nonparametric alternative for paired or repeated-measure data when differences are skewed or not normally distributed, comparing median difference against zero.
zh_examples: 配对数据的差值明显偏态，还能用什么检验？
前后两次测量不满足正态性应该选哪种方法？
两组配对样本的中位数有没有差异怎么判断？
en_examples: My paired differences are skewed; what test can I use instead?
What should I use for before-after data that fails the normality check?
How can I test whether the median difference of paired samples differs from zero?

test.mannwhitney.en_description: Nonparametric test comparing two independent groups when normality or equal-variance assumptions fail, assessing whether one group tends to have larger values.
zh_examples: 两组独立样本不满足正态分布，用什么方法比较？
方差不齐的时候两组差异怎么检验？
数据是等级或者偏态的，两组该选什么检验？
en_examples: How do I compare two independent groups when the data are not normal?
What test should I use if the two groups have unequal variances?
Can I compare two groups with ordinal or heavily skewed data?

test.kruskal.en_description: Nonparametric test for differences among three or more independent groups when ANOVA assumptions are violated, based on rank comparisons across groups.
zh_examples: 多组数据不满足方差分析条件怎么办？
三组以上用什么非参数方法看差异？
组间差异显著之后还要怎么做两两比较？
en_examples: What can I use instead of ANOVA when its assumptions are violated?
How do I check for differences among three or more independent groups nonparametrically?
What should I do after finding a significant difference across multiple groups?

test.friedman.en_description: Nonparametric test for repeated-measure or randomized block designs with multiple conditions on the same subjects, when normality assumptions do not hold.
zh_examples: 同一批被试在多个条件下的表现怎么比较？
重复测量数据不服从正态分布该用什么方法？
三个处理条件之间有没有显著差异怎么检验？
en_examples: How do I compare the same subjects across multiple conditions nonparametrically?
What test fits repeated-measures data that are not normally distributed?
Is there a way to test differences among three treatment conditions within subjects?

test.cochran.en_description: Nonparametric test for differences in binary responses measured repeatedly on the same subjects across three or more conditions or time points.
zh_examples: 同一批病人在三个时间点的用药有效率不一样，怎么检验这种差异？
我做的是同一批被试三种条件下的是/否回答，能用什么方法看整体有没有差异？
重复测量的二分类结果，三个组以上怎么比较？
en_examples: How do I test whether binary outcomes differ across three or more repeated conditions on the same subjects?
I have yes/no responses from the same patients at four time points — which test should I use?
What's the appropriate nonparametric test for matched binary data with more than two related groups?

test.chi2.en_description: Tests whether two categorical variables are independent using contingency tables; suitable for association testing and group difference comparisons.
zh_examples: 性别和是否购买之间有没有关系，怎么做检验？
列联表里两个分类变量独立吗，用什么方法？
想知道不同学历的人在某项选择上比例是否不同，怎么检验？
en_examples: Is there a significant association between gender and product purchase in this contingency table?
How do I test whether two categorical variables are independent?
Which test should I use to compare proportions across groups for categorical data?

test.gof.en_description: Checks whether observed frequencies match an expected theoretical distribution or specified proportions; used for distribution fit assessment.
zh_examples: 我想看观察到的各组人数符不符合 1:1:1 的预期比例，怎么做？
检验数据是不是服从某个理论分布用什么方法？
实际频数和期望频数差多少才算显著，怎么算？
en_examples: How can I check whether observed category counts match expected proportions?
Which test compares observed frequencies against a theoretical distribution?
Is my sample distributed uniformly across the four groups?

test.fisher.en_description: Exact test for association in 2×2 contingency tables when sample sizes are small and expected cell counts fall below five.
zh_examples: 我的四格表里有格子期望频数小于5，能用卡方吗？
样本量很小的 2×2 表怎么检验两个变量有没有关系？
两个比例比较但总样本只有二十几例，用什么检验？
en_examples: Some expected cell counts are below 5 — should I use an exact test instead of chi-square?
What's the right test for a 2×2 table with very small sample size?
How do I compare two proportions when the total sample is tiny?

model.correlation.en_description: Measures strength and direction of linear association among continuous variables using Pearson, Spearman, Kendall or partial correlation.
zh_examples: 我想看看这些变量之间哪些有相关关系，用什么方法？
数据不满足正态分布，相关系数怎么选？
控制了年龄之后，两个变量还相关吗，怎么算？
en_examples: Which correlation coefficient should I use if the data aren't normally distributed?
How do I check for linear relationships among my continuous variables?
Can I compute the correlation between two variables while controlling for a third?

model.canonical.en_description: Quantifies overall correlation between two sets of variables, identifying linear combinations that maximize their shared association.
zh_examples: 两组变量整体上关系强不强，怎么分析？
我有多个自变量和多个因变量，怎么找它们之间的相关模式？
想看生活方式指标和健康指标两组之间怎么关联，用什么方法？
en_examples: How can I measure the overall relationship between two groups of variables?
I have several predictors and several outcomes — what method shows their joint correlation structure?
Which technique finds linear combinations of two variable sets that correlate most?

model.vif.en_description: Checks multicollinearity among predictors before regression using variance inflation factors and tolerance, flagging severely correlated independent variables.
zh_examples: 回归之前怎么判断自变量之间有没有严重共线性？
变量之间相关性很高，会不会影响回归结果，该看什么指标？
计算出来的方差膨胀因子很大，要怎么处理？
en_examples: How do I check whether my predictors are too collinear before running a regression?
Which diagnostic tells me if independent variables are inflating coefficient variance?
What VIF values are considered a problem and what should I do about them?

model.linear.en_description: Quantifies direction and magnitude of predictor effects on a continuous outcome with coefficients, standard errors, t-values and R², for explanation and prediction.
zh_examples: 因变量是连续的，想看看各个因素影响有多大该用什么方法？
怎么用自变量去预测一个连续的数值，还要能解释每个变量的贡献？
回归结果里的系数、t 值和 R² 分别怎么看？
en_examples: I have a continuous outcome and want to estimate how each factor affects it. What method should I use?
How can I build a model that predicts a numeric value and explains each predictor's contribution?
How do I interpret the coefficients and R-squared from my regression output?

model.ridge.en_description: Stabilizes regression coefficients under strong predictor collinearity or few samples relative to variables by applying L2 penalty regularization.
zh_examples: 自变量之间高度相关，普通回归系数变得很不稳定怎么办？
样本量比变量还少，回归跑不起来有什么办法？
正则化参数应该怎么选？
en_examples: My predictors are highly correlated and the coefficients are unstable — what can I do?
I have fewer observations than variables; how can I still fit a stable regression?
How should I choose the penalty strength for a shrinkage model?

model.lasso.en_description: Fits a regression that shrinks useless coefficients to zero with L1 penalty, performing automatic feature selection among many predictors.
zh_examples: 自变量特别多，想让模型自动筛掉没用的变量该怎么做？
怎么做变量选择，同时还能得到预测模型？
哪些特征真正对结果有影响，怎么自动识别？
en_examples: I have too many features and want the model to drop the irrelevant ones automatically. What should I use?
Is there a method that does variable selection and prediction at the same time?
How can I identify which predictors actually matter in a high-dimensional dataset?

model.elasticnet.en_description: Combines L1 and L2 penalties to handle grouped or strongly correlated predictors where Lasso keeps only one and ridge keeps all.
zh_examples: 有一组变量彼此高度相关，怎么让它们一起进模型或者一起被删掉？
Lasso 在相关变量里只留一个，这种情况用什么替代？
想要既能筛变量又不丢掉成组特征怎么办？
en_examples: My predictors fall into correlated groups; how do I keep or drop them together?
Lasso only keeps one of a set of correlated variables — what's the alternative?
I need both sparsity and stability with highly correlated features. Which method fits?

model.logistic.en_description: Models binary, ordinal or multinomial categorical outcomes, estimating odds ratios to explain factor effects on classification probability.
zh_examples: 结果只有是和否两类，想分析哪些因素有影响该用什么？
二分类问题里优势比是什么意思，怎么解释？
因变量是有序的等级（比如低中高），能用回归分析吗？
en_examples: My outcome is yes/no and I want to know which factors affect the odds — what model fits?
How do I interpret odds ratios from a binary classification model?
Can I use a regression when my outcome is an ordered category like low, medium, high?

model.probit.en_description: Models binary outcomes assuming a latent normally distributed variable, useful when normal-theory assumptions underlie the classification problem.
zh_examples: 我的因变量只有0和1，但我觉得背后有个正态潜变量，该用什么模型？
二分类结果用 probit 和 logit 有什么区别，什么时候选前者？
研究某种行为是否发生，假设存在潜在连续倾向，怎么做回归？
en_examples: I have a 0/1 dependent variable and believe there's a continuous latent trait behind it—what model should I use?
When is probit preferable to logit for modeling binary choices?
How do I estimate a binary response model assuming a normally distributed latent variable?

model.robust.en_description: Checks whether regression conclusions hold under heteroskedasticity, outliers, and alternative specifications using robust standard errors.
zh_examples: 结果里好像有异方差，怎么处理才靠谱？
怎么检验我的回归结论是不是被几个极端值带偏了？
审稿人让我做稳健性检验，一般要做哪些？
en_examples: How do I fix heteroskedasticity in my regression results?
My coefficients might be driven by a few outliers—how can I check that?
What robustness checks should I run to convince reviewers my findings are stable?

model.mediation.en_description: Tests whether an effect of A on B operates through an intermediate variable M, using Baron-Kenny steps or bootstrap indirect effects.
zh_examples: 我想验证自变量是通过某个中间变量影响因变量的，怎么做？
中介效应的显著性要用什么方法检验比较合适？
间接效应的置信区间该怎么算？
en_examples: How can I show that my independent variable works through an intermediate variable?
What's the best way to test whether an indirect effect is significant?
Do I need bootstrapping to test a mediation hypothesis?

model.moderation.en_description: Examines when an effect becomes stronger or weaker via interaction terms and simple slopes, clarifying boundary conditions of a relationship.
zh_examples: 怎么判断一个变量会不会改变另一个变量的影响大小？
加了交互项之后系数怎么解读？
想看在不同条件下主效应是否一样强，该怎么做？
en_examples: How do I test whether the effect of X on Y depends on another variable?
How should I interpret an interaction term in my regression?
I want to know if my effect is stronger in one group than another—what approach fits?

model.chained.en_description: Decomposes indirect effects when influence passes through two or more mediators in sequence, estimating each link's contribution.
zh_examples: 影响要经过两个中间变量先后传递，这种路径怎么检验？
串行中介和并行中介有什么区别，怎么选？
怎么把总效应分解成几条链条上的间接效应？
en_examples: My effect passes through two mediators in sequence—how do I test that pathway?
What's the difference between serial and parallel multiple mediation?
How do I decompose an indirect effect across a chain of variables?

model.gamma.en_description: Fits positive continuous outcomes like durations or costs whose variance grows with the mean, using a gamma distribution and log link.
zh_examples: 我的因变量是花费金额，都是正数而且方差越来越大，用什么模型？
保险赔付金额或等待时长这种数据怎么建模？
gamma 回归和对数线性回归有什么差别？
en_examples: My dependent variable is positive cost data with variance increasing with the mean—what model fits?
How do I model claim amounts or waiting times that are always positive?
When should I choose a gamma GLM over a log-transformed linear model?

model.poisson.en_description: Models count outcomes with log link, suitable when the dependent variable is a nonnegative count such as occurrences, cases, or event totals.
zh_examples: 我的因变量是每个月发生的次数，应该用什么模型？
事件计数数据怎么分析影响因素？
数据里有很多零计数，有什么回归方法？
en_examples: My dependent variable is a count of events per month — what model should I use?
How can I analyze factors affecting the number of occurrences when the outcome is a count?
What regression works when my outcome is the number of cases recorded in each group?

model.gee.en_description: Handles correlated observations within clusters, estimating population-average effects when only overall average relationships are of interest.
zh_examples: 数据是按班级/医院分组的，想看总体平均效应用什么方法？
同一个病人反复测量好几次，怎么建模？
组内观测有相关性，普通回归不适用怎么办？
en_examples: Data are clustered by school and I only care about population-average effects — what should I use?
Patients were measured repeatedly over time; how do I model this properly?
Observations within groups are correlated, so standard regression gives biased errors — what's the fix?

model.glmm.en_description: Extends GLMs with random effects for clustered or multilevel data with non-normal responses, capturing both fixed and group-specific variation.
zh_examples: 数据分层嵌套，因变量还是二分类/计数，用什么模型？
组间差异很大，想加入随机效应怎么建？
多层数据的非正态响应该怎么分析？
en_examples: My data are nested and the outcome is binary — which model fits?
Groups differ a lot and I want to add random effects; how?
How do I analyze a non-normal outcome in multilevel clustered data?

model.mixed.en_description: Fits linear or nonlinear models with random intercepts and slopes for nested or repeated-measures designs capturing subject-specific variation.
zh_examples: 重复测量数据，个体内多次观测，怎么建模？
有随机截距和随机斜率的模型怎么做？
嵌套结构的数据用什么回归合适？
en_examples: I have repeated measures per subject — what model should I fit?
How do I include both random intercepts and random slopes?
What regression handles data nested within groups over time?

ml.kmeans.en_description: Partitions samples into k spherical clusters based on numeric features, useful for customer segmentation and discovering group structure.

ml.hierarchical.en_description: Builds a dendrogram of nested clusters without pre-specifying group count, revealing hierarchical structure via various linkage criteria.

ml.fcm.en_description: Soft clustering assigning membership degrees to each point for all clusters, ideal when boundary samples should not be forced into a single hard class.
zh_examples: 有些客户感觉介于两个群体之间，能不能给出他属于各类的程度？

不想把边界样本硬分到某一类，有什么办法？

ml.random_forest.en_description: Ensemble of decision trees providing a stable, low-tuning baseline predictor with feature importance and out-of-bag error for tabular data.
zh_examples: 表格数据想先做个比较稳的基线预测模型，用什么好？
随机森林的特征重要性怎么看？

ml.xgboost.en_description: Gradient boosting framework maximizing predictive accuracy through iterative tree boosting with early stopping, suited for competitions and tuned modeling.
zh_examples: 想把预测精度做上去，愿意花时间调参，用什么模型？

ml.lightgbm.en_description: Histogram-based gradient boosting that trains fast on large-scale, high-dimensional data, ideal when training speed is the bottleneck.
zh_examples: 数据量很大、特征也多，训练太慢了怎么办？

ml.adaboost.en_description: Sequentially reweights simple weak learners into a strong classifier, useful when combining many inexpensive base models for prediction.
zh_examples: 能不能用一堆简单模型组合成一个效果好的分类器？

ml.gbdt.en_description: Ensemble of trees fit sequentially to negative gradients; suits structured-data prediction, feature importance, and tabular classification/regression tasks.
zh_examples: 梯度提升到底是在拟合什么东西？

树模型做特征重要性排序靠谱吗？

ml.svm.en_description: Maximum-margin classifier using kernel tricks; suited to medium-sized, high-dimensional data with fairly separable class boundaries.
zh_examples: 数据维度挺高但样本不多，用什么分类比较好？

ml.knn.en_description: Instance-based learner predicting from nearest neighbors; a simple, training-free baseline for small-scale classification and regression.

ml.nb.en_description: Probabilistic classifier assuming feature independence; a fast baseline for text and high-dimensional sparse features.
zh_examples: 做文本分类有没有又快又简单的基线？

ml.mlp.en_description: Fully connected neural network for strongly nonlinear relationships; suits predictive modeling when data volume is sufficient.
zh_examples: 变量之间关系明显是非线性的，该用什么模型？

en_examples: My features have strongly nonlinear effects; what model should I use?

ml.rbf.en_description: Shallow network with localized radial basis responses; useful when training samples are limited but local structure matters.
zh_examples: 样本不太多但想做局部逼近，有什么浅层网络可用？

ml.trees.en_description: Builds interpretable binary trees using Gini or entropy splitting to produce if-then rules and feature importance for classification tasks.
zh_examples: 我想把分类结果变成人能看懂的规则，该用什么模型？

ml.lda_qda.en_description: Classifies observations with linear or quadratic discriminant boundaries and simultaneously yields dimensionality reduction for visualization.

series.arima.en_description: Models a univariate stationary-after-differencing time series with autoregressive and moving-average terms for short-term forecasting and diagnostics.

series.sarima.en_description: Extends ARIMA with seasonal terms to capture stable periodic patterns such as monthly or quarterly cycles for seasonal forecasting.

series.garch.en_description: Captures conditional heteroskedasticity and clusters of volatility in financial return series to forecast time-varying risk.

series.var.en_description: Models multiple interdependent time series jointly to analyze dynamic interactions and generate impulse response functions.

怎么做脉冲响应分析？
哪个模型能看变量之间的因果传导？

series.adf.en_description: Tests whether a time series is stationary before modeling to avoid spurious regression; used in time series forecasting and stationarity diagnostics.

series.granger.en_description: Determines whether one time series has predictive power for another, capturing lead-lag relationships in forecasting and causality analysis.

这两个变量谁先动谁后动，能测出来吗？

zh_examples: 权重都定好了，怎么根据离最优方案的远近给这些方案排个名？
有没有一种方法能算出每个方案离理想解有多近然后排序？
想把各方案按接近最好和远离最差的程度排个顺序该怎么做？
en_examples: Given fixed weights, how do I rank alternatives by their distance from the ideal solution?
I want a method that scores how close each option is to the best possible outcome.
How can I order the alternatives based on proximity to ideal and anti-ideal points?

eval.vikor.en_description: Ranks alternatives via group utility and regret measures, ideal when compromises are needed and avoiding options that perform poorly on any single criterion.
zh_examples: 有没有办法在排序时防止某个指标特别差的方案被选出来？
想在多个方案之间做折中选择，让整体表现和最差项都能兼顾，怎么做？
除了综合排名，还想看看每个方案最差的一项表现，用什么方法？
en_examples: How can I rank options while penalizing any option that is very bad on one criterion?
I need a compromise ranking that balances overall utility and worst-case performance.
Which method avoids selecting an alternative that scores poorly on a single criterion?

eval.rsr.en_description: Converts multi-indicator values into ranks and computes a composite ratio for tiered evaluation, useful with many heterogeneous, differently scaled indicators.
zh_examples: 指标特别多而且单位都不一样，能不能用排名的方式做综合评价？
想把评价结果分成几个等级，有什么简单的方法？
数据不太符合正态分布，用什么综合评价方法比较稳妥？
en_examples: I have many indicators with different units—can I evaluate using ranks instead?
How do I turn a multi-indicator score into a few performance tiers?
What ranking-based method works well when the data is not normally distributed?

eval.dea.en_description: Evaluates relative efficiency of decision units with multiple inputs and outputs by constructing a production frontier, suited for benchmarking.
zh_examples: 有好几个单位，每个都有多种投入和产出，怎么比较它们的效率？
想知道哪些决策单元是有效率的、哪些存在浪费，该用什么方法？
怎么给每个部门算出相对效率分数并找出标杆？
en_examples: How can I compare the efficiency of several units each with multiple inputs and outputs?
Which method identifies efficient and inefficient decision units?
I need to benchmark departments using their input and output data—what works?

eval.fuzzy.en_description: Evaluates alternatives with vague qualitative criteria using membership degrees and aggregation operators, suitable for rankings where judgments like good or average are fuzzy.
zh_examples: 评价指标里都是“较好、一般”这种模糊说法，怎么给方案打分排序？
这种主观评语类的多指标评价该用什么方法处理？
en_examples: How do I rank alternatives when the criteria are judged with vague words like good or average?
Which method handles multi-criteria evaluation with linguistic ratings?

eval.grey.en_description: Ranks alternatives by measuring geometric closeness to a reference sequence, ideal for small samples with incomplete information in decision-making.
zh_examples: 样本就十几个，信息也不全，怎么衡量各方案跟理想情况的接近程度？
数据很少的时候怎么做方案优劣排序？
en_examples: I have very few samples and missing info; how can I rank options against an ideal reference?
What method works for ranking alternatives with limited data?

domain.wordfreq.en_description: Counts term occurrences in a corpus to surface the most common words, a first step for text exploration, word clouds, and content overview.
zh_examples: 我想先看看这批评论里出现最多的词有哪些？
有没有办法快速统计一篇文章里的高频词？
en_examples: How can I quickly find the most frequent words in these reviews?
What is the standard first step to summarize text content by word counts?

domain.tfidf.en_description: Weights terms by how often they appear in a document versus the corpus to extract distinctive keywords rather than generic frequent words.
zh_examples: 怎么从一批文档里挑出最能代表每篇的关键词？
通用高频词太多，怎么找有区分度的词？
en_examples: How do I extract keywords that uniquely represent each document?
Which method downweights common words and highlights distinguishing terms?

domain.sentiment.en_description: Classifies reviews, comments, or interviews as positive, negative, or neutral using lexicons or supervised classifiers, for bulk opinion labeling.
zh_examples: 想给几万条评论自动标上好评差评，该怎么做？
访谈文本里的正负面态度怎么批量识别？
en_examples: How can I automatically label tens of thousands of reviews as positive or negative?
What approach batches opinion classification over interview text?

domain.lda.en_description: Discovers latent topics and their word distributions across an unlabeled document collection, when topics are unknown and must be inferred.
zh_examples: 这批文档没有主题标签，能不能让模型自己归纳出几个主题？
怎么自动把大量文章分成不同的主题？
en_examples: Can a model discover hidden topics in an unlabeled document collection?
How do I automatically group large numbers of documents by topic?

domain.km.en_description: Estimates the survival function and median survival time from follow-up data with censoring, used to visualize and compare survival differences between groups.
zh_examples: 我想看看病人的生存曲线，怎么画？
随访数据里有人失访了，中位生存期怎么算？
两组患者的生存时间差异怎么比较？
en_examples: How do I plot a survival curve from follow-up data with censoring?
What is the median survival time in my dataset?
How can I compare survival between two groups?

domain.cox.en_description: Models how multiple covariates affect the hazard of an event, providing hazard ratios and p-values for risk factor analysis in survival studies.
zh_examples: 想分析几个因素对生存时间的影响，用什么模型？
怎么做多因素的风险因素分析并报告风险比？
比例风险的假定要怎么检验？
en_examples: Which factors significantly affect survival time?
How do I interpret hazard ratios from a regression model?
Is my data suitable for a proportional hazards model?

domain.nomogram.en_description: Converts a fitted Cox model into a visual point-based chart for individual risk prediction, enabling bedside estimation of survival probabilities.
zh_examples: 能不能把模型做成一张可以直接打分的预测图？
怎么给每个病人算一个个体化的风险评分？
预测模型怎么验证准不准？
en_examples: How can I turn my model into a printable prediction chart?
How do I calculate an individual patient's risk score?
How do I validate the accuracy of a prediction model?

domain.competing.en_description: Handles situations where multiple mutually exclusive event types occur, estimating cumulative incidence functions instead of naive Kaplan-Meier estimates.
zh_examples: 病人可能死于癌症也可能死于其他病，这种数据怎么做？
多种终点事件同时存在时累积发生率怎么算？
用普通生存分析处理竞争事件会有什么问题？
en_examples: How do I analyze data where patients can die from different causes?
How do I estimate cumulative incidence with multiple event types?
Why is Kaplan-Meier inappropriate for competing events?

domain.reliability.en_description: Assesses questionnaire scale quality using Cronbach's alpha for internal consistency and KMO/Bartlett tests for factorability before factor analysis.
zh_examples: 问卷回收了，怎么检验量表的信度和效度？
Cronbach α 多少算合格？
做因子分析之前需要通过什么检验？
en_examples: How do I check the reliability of my questionnaire?
What KMO value do I need before factor analysis?
Is a Cronbach's alpha of 0.6 acceptable?

domain.nps.en_description: Computes NPS from a single 0-10 recommendation question by subtracting the percentage of detractors from promoters, common in customer satisfaction surveys.
zh_examples: 问卷里有一道 0 到 10 分的推荐意愿题，怎么算分？
NPS 的推荐者和贬损者是怎么划分的？
怎么报告和比较不同群体的推荐意愿？
en_examples: How do I calculate the score from a 0-10 recommendation question?
How are promoters and detractors defined?
How do I compare recommendation scores across customer groups?

domain.kano.en_description: Classifies product or service requirements into must-have, more-is-better, and indifferent categories from satisfaction survey responses, useful in market research and questionnaire analysis.
zh_examples: 用户需求分不清哪些是基本功能哪些是加分项，怎么区分？
做问卷调研后，怎么判断哪些功能是必须有的，哪些做多了也没用？
客户满意度调查的数据怎么归类成必备型和期望型需求？
en_examples: How can I tell which survey items are basic requirements versus nice-to-have extras?
What method sorts customer needs into must-have, performance, and indifferent categories?
I have satisfaction questionnaire data — how do I classify feature importance?

domain.maxdiff.en_description: Forces respondents to choose most and least important items from sets, yielding preference share estimates when many options suffer from rating inflation.
zh_examples: 问卷里大家都把选项打满分，怎么逼他们做出真正取舍？
产品功能太多，想让用户排个真正的优先级该怎么做？
怎么估计不同功能在用户心里的相对偏好份额？
en_examples: Respondents rate everything as important — how do I get them to make real trade-offs?
How can I estimate relative preference shares among many product features?
What survey technique forces priority ranking instead of giving everything 5 stars?

domain.conjoint.en_description: Measures utilities and relative importance of product attributes from choices among attribute combinations, suited for multi-attribute product design and pricing studies.
zh_examples: 产品有价格、功能、外观好几个属性，想知道用户最看重哪个？
怎么评估不同配置组合的吸引力？
新产品的属性水平怎么定价和组合才最受用户欢迎？
en_examples: How do I find out which product attribute matters most to buyers?
How can I estimate consumer utility for each level of a product attribute?
What analysis shows the trade-offs people make between price, features, and brand?

domain.psm.en_description: Estimates acceptable price ranges and optimal price points from willingness-to-pay data, helping set prices customers still accept rather than classic four-question PSM.
zh_examples: 定价定多少用户还能接受？怎么从调研数据看出来？
想找出用户愿意付的价格区间和最优点在哪。
价格上调多少客户不会大量流失，有没有从问卷估的方法？
en_examples: What price can we charge before customers push back?
How do I estimate the acceptable price range from survey data?
Where is the optimal price point based on willingness-to-pay responses?

domain.control.en_description: Monitors continuous production data with control charts to detect when a process drifts out of control and flags alarm points for quality engineers.
zh_examples: 产线数据一直监控着，怎么判断过程是不是失控了？
均值有没有慢慢漂移，用什么图能看出来？
怎么给生产过程设置告警，出现异常点自动提示？
en_examples: How do I know from monitoring data whether my process has gone out of control?
Which chart detects a slow drift in process mean over time?
How can I set up alarm points for production quality monitoring?

domain.capability.en_description: After confirming process stability, computes capability indices like Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk to assess whether output meets specification limits.
zh_examples: 过程已经稳定了，怎么判断它能不能满足规格要求？
Cp 和 Cpk 有什么区别，怎么算我的产线能力？
规格上下限定了，产品合格率能达到什么水平？
en_examples: My process is stable — how do I check whether it meets specification limits?
What do Cp and Cpk tell me about my production line?
How do I calculate process capability from measurement data and tolerances?

domain.weibull.en_description: Models time-to-failure data to estimate failure distributions, shape and scale parameters, and reliability curves for product lifetime and durability assessment.
zh_examples: 这批零件的失效时间想看看服从什么分布，怎么分析寿命可靠性？
产品寿命数据能画出可靠度曲线吗，怎么估计参数？
想知道平均无故障时间和失效率随时间怎么变化
en_examples: How do I fit a failure time distribution to lifetime data and get reliability curves?
Which model should I use to estimate shape and scale parameters from warranty return data?
Can I predict when the failure rate will start increasing for these components?

domain.meta.en_description: Combines effect sizes across multiple studies on the same question, assessing heterogeneity and pooled estimates for evidence synthesis and systematic reviews.
zh_examples: 十几篇研究结论不一致，能不能合成一个总的效应量？
怎么把不同论文里的风险比汇总起来，异质性怎么看？
做了系统综述之后合并结果应该用哪个模型？
en_examples: How do I combine effect sizes from several studies into one pooled estimate?
Which model should I use when there is high heterogeneity across trials?
Can I pool odds ratios from different papers and produce a forest plot?
